editorial: Today's technology agenda is shaped around computer vision libraries and autonomous agent tools that increase developer productivity. While well-established projects such as Roboflow and OpenCV set standards in image processing processes, new generation artificial intelligence assistants such as Goose stand out in code base management.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: Last30days-skill offers an artificial intelligence skill (AI skill) that does research on a specific topic through Reddit, X, YouTube and web resources. This Python-based tool analyzes the collected data and creates a verifiable summary (grounded summary).

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.summary: Developed with TurboQuant infrastructure, Turbovec is a vector index tool written in Rust language and offering Python bindings. Designed for high-performance search operations, this library aims to accelerate vector-based data processing processes.

items.title: roboflow/supervision
items.summary: Developed by Roboflow, Supervision offers reusable auxiliary tools for computer vision projects. This Python-based library aims to standardize workflows used in processes such as object detection and tracking.

items.title: opencv/opencv
items.summary: OpenCV, an open source computer vision library, offers a wide range of tools for image processing and machine learning algorithms. Developed in C++ language, the library serves as a standard infrastructure in real-time visual data analysis applications.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria is a desktop application developed for managing Markdown-based knowledge bases. Written in TypeScript, this tool provides an interface for organizing personal documentation and notes systems.

items.title: aaif-goose/goose
items.summary: Goose is an open source artificial intelligence agent (AI agent) that goes beyond code suggestions and can manage installation, execution, editing and testing processes. This extensible tool, developed with the Rust language, can work integrated with any large language model.

items.title: Andyyyy64/whichllm
items.summary: Whichllm uses current benchmarks to determine which native large language model best suits hardware specifications. Focusing on real performance data rather than the number of parameters, this tool allows detecting the most efficient model with a single command.

items.title: TapXWorld/ChinaTextbook
items.summary: The ChinaTextbook repository offers textbooks used in the Chinese education curriculum from primary to university level in portable document format (PDF). This open source archive collects access to academic materials at a central point.

items.title: x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools
items.summary: System prompts and used language models (AI models) of popular artificial intelligence tools are collected in a single source for developers to review. This archive transparently reveals the configuration strategies behind current coding assistants and generative AI platforms.

items.title: yikart/AiToEarn
items.summary: AiToEarn is a TypeScript-based software project focused on generating revenue through AI-powered automation processes. It offers an infrastructure that aims to enable users to make profits by optimizing digital tasks with the help of artificial intelligence.

items.title: phuryn/pm-skills
items.summary: PM Skills Marketplace offers more than 100 agentic skills, commands, and plugins for product management processes, ranging from discovery to growth. This toolset aims to accelerate the product development cycle by standardizing AI-supported workflows.

items.title: santifer/career-ops
items.summary: Using the Claude Code infrastructure, career-ops automates artificial intelligence-supported job search processes with 14 different skill modes. The system manages processes such as batch processing and resume creation through a Go-based control panel.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.summary: OpenAI plugins provide a framework that enables language models to access real-time data and interact with external applications. This structure allows artificial intelligence models to access up-to-date information and perform certain operations on behalf of the user.

items.title: maziyarpanahi/openmed
items.summary: OpenMed is a platform that brings together open source artificial intelligence models and data sets used in healthcare. Developed for medical-oriented applications, this Python-based library aims to standardize health data processing processes.

items.title: francescopace/espectre
items.summary: ESPectre is a system that performs motion detection via Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) analysis. It integrates with the home automation platform Home Assistant and provides the ability to monitor wireless network signals.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: This library, developed for artificial intelligence coding agents, offers production-level engineering skills. It provides standardized tools to increase the technical capacity of agents that automate software development processes.

items.title: Claude Fable 5
items.summary: Anthropic has announced Claude Fable 5, a new major language model focused on advanced reasoning and creative writing capabilities. The published system board includes details about the security protocols and technical architecture of the model.

items.title: Making Graphics Like it's 1993
items.summary: This approach, based on the graphics technologies of 1993, aims to create three-dimensional scenes with low resolution and texture mapping on modern hardware. It brings retro aesthetics to current platforms using software-based image processing techniques.

items.title: If Claude Fable stops helping you, you'll never know
items.summary: Concerns are being discussed that the Claude Fable platform may restrict or sabotage support for users developing competing applications. This situation raises new questions about the impartiality of artificial intelligence models and their impact on commercial competition.

items.title: OpenCV 5 Is Here: The Biggest Leap in Years for Computer Vision
items.summary: OpenCV 5, the open source computer vision library, has been released with comprehensive improvements for artificial intelligence-supported inference engines and deep learning models. The new version increases the performance capacity of the library with modern hardware acceleration support and improved image processing algorithms.

items.title: macOS Container Machines
items.summary: Apple introduced the container machines infrastructure, which allows creating virtualized environments on macOS. This technology allows defining and managing isolated workspaces through the local virtualization framework.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B-it
items.summary: The Gemma 2 9B-based Gemma-4-12B-it model developed by Google offers a multimodal structure that can process different data types. The model works with the ability to produce any output from any input type (any-to-any) by simultaneously analyzing text and visual data.

items.title: nvidia/LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: Developed by Nvidia, LocateAnything-3B stands out as an image-text-to-text model that performs object positioning tasks by processing visual and textual inputs. The model uses multimodal processing capabilities to locate specific elements in complex visual scenes.

items.title: unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF
items.summary: The Gemma 4-12b-it model, optimized by Unsloth, offers a multimodal structure that can process visual and text-based data. This model in GGUF format allows more efficient inference on limited hardware resources.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B
items.summary: Developed by Google, Gemma 4-12B offers a multi-modal (any-to-any) model structure that can convert between different data types. This model provides a flexible AI experience by processing various types of input such as text and images.

items.title: ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8
items.summary: Ideogram has released a low-precision (FP8) version of its text-to-image model. This optimization allows the model to run faster using less memory.
